detail.longDescription: University of Central Florida: UCF Libraries Launches New Space Research Portal. “As America’s Space University, UCF has long been at the forefront of space-related research. Now, UCF Libraries is making it easier to discover and explore that work with the launch of the UCF Space Research Portal, a new online collection showcasing space-related scholarship produced by UCF researchers.
